```{r setup, message = FALSE}
source("R/TEST_Optimizations/libraries.R")
source("R/TEST_Optimizations/functions.R")
```

```{r define_paths_and_constants}
# ---- File paths ----
PATHS <- list(
  boym      = "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UCB-O365/Documents/MCM-LTER_Met/met stations/mcmlter-clim_boym_15min-20250205.csv",
  hoem      = "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UCB-O365/Documents/MCM-LTER_Met/met stations/mcmlter-clim_hoem_15min-20250205.csv",
  cohm      = "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UCB-O365/Documents/MCM-LTER_Met/met stations/mcmlter-clim_cohm_15min-20250205.csv",
  tarm      = "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UCB-O365/Documents/MCM-LTER_Met/met stations/mcmlter-clim_tarm_15min-20250205.csv",
  airt_elb  = "Data/air_temp_ELBBB.csv",
  airt_wlb  = "Data/air_temp_WLBBB.csv",
  ice       = "Data/mcmlter-lake-ice_thickness-20250218_0_2025.csv",
  albedo    = "Data/AlbedoModel.csv"
)

# ---- Physical and model constants (single source of truth) ----
k_ice <- 2.3
rho_ice <- 917
c_ice <- 2100

CONSTANTS <- list(
  # Thermodynamic
  sigma      = 5.67e-8,
  emissivity = 0.97,
  Tf         = 273.15,
  L_f        = 334000,
  xLv        = 2.501e6,
  xLs        = 2.834e6,
  # Ice properties
  k          = k_ice,
  rho        = rho_ice,
  alpha      = k_ice / (rho_ice * c_ice),
  # Atmospheric
  R          = 8.314,
  Ma         = 0.029,
  Ca         = 1005,
  epsilon    = 0.622,
  # Bulk transfer
  Ch         = 1.3e-3,
  Ce         = 1.3e-3,
  Chi        = 0.43,
  # Model grid
  dx         = 0.10,
  dt         = 1/24,
  L_initial  = 3.60
)

# ---- Temporal filters ----
start_filter   <- as.POSIXct("2016-12-21 00:00:00")
wlb_end_filter <- as.POSIXct("2023-11-01 00:00:00")
lwr_extend_to  <- as.POSIXct("2025-01-31 23:45:00")
ice_start      <- as.POSIXct("2016-12-01")
ice_end        <- as.POSIXct("2024-02-01")
lake_name      <- "East Lake Bonney"
```

```{r load_data, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
BOYM       <- read_csv(PATHS$boym)
HOEM       <- read_csv(PATHS$hoem)
COHM       <- read_csv(PATHS$cohm)
TARM       <- read_csv(PATHS$tarm)
airt_elb   <- read_csv(PATHS$airt_elb)
airt_wlb   <- read_csv(PATHS$airt_wlb)
albedo_raw <- read_csv(PATHS$albedo)
ice_raw    <- read_csv(PATHS$ice)
```

```{r observed_pathway, warning = FALSE}
# Prepare observed inputs, apply no warming
inputs      <- prepare_elb_model_inputs(
  BOYM, HOEM, COHM, TARM,
  airt_elb, airt_wlb,
  ice_raw, albedo_raw,
  constants      = CONSTANTS,
  start_filter   = start_filter,
  wlb_end_filter = wlb_end_filter,
  lwr_extend_to  = lwr_extend_to,
  ice_start      = ice_start,
  ice_end        = ice_end,
  n_years        = 6.95,
  lake_name      = lake_name
)

prepped_obs <- prepare_model_input(inputs$time_series,
                                   warming_rate = 0.000,
                                   constants    = CONSTANTS)
results_obs <- run_ice_model(prepped_obs, constants = CONSTANTS)
```

```{r scenario_pathway, warning = FALSE}
# Build climatology-based scenario, apply no warming or offsets
clim_scenario <- build_climate_scenario(
  BOYM      = BOYM,
  HOEM      = HOEM,
  COHM      = COHM,
  airt_elb  = airt_elb,
  airt_wlb  = airt_wlb,
  albedo_df = albedo_raw,
  constants      = CONSTANTS,
  wlb_end_filter = wlb_end_filter,
  lake_name      = lake_name,
  year_start     = 2024,
  year_end       = 2050,
  flat_offsets        = list(),   # no offsets — baseline scenario
  seasonal_adjustments = list()   # no adjustments — baseline scenario
)

prepped_scen <- prepare_model_input(clim_scenario,
                                    warming_rate = 0.000,
                                    constants    = CONSTANTS)
results_scen <- run_ice_model(prepped_scen, constants = CONSTANTS)
```

```{r plot_observed}
# plot_scenario expects a raw scenario/prepped df with T_air, SW_in etc.
# Use inputs$time_series for the observed input plot, not prepped_obs
# (prepped_obs has delta_T added but is otherwise the same)
plot_scenario(inputs$time_series,
              scenario_label = "Observed (no warming)",
              smooth = "month")

plot_ice_model(results_obs,
               ice_thickness = inputs$ice_thickness,
               title = "East Lake Bonney — Observed",
               smooth = "week")
```

```{r plot_scenario}
plot_scenario(clim_scenario,
              scenario_label = "Baseline scenario 2024–2050",
              smooth = "month")

plot_ice_model(results_scen,
               title = "East Lake Bonney — Baseline scenario",
               subtitle = "No warming applied | Climatological forcing 2024–2050",
               smooth = "month")
```
```{r}
clim_scenario_warm_1 <- build_climate_scenario(
  BOYM      = BOYM,
  HOEM      = HOEM,
  COHM      = COHM,
  airt_elb  = airt_elb,
  airt_wlb  = airt_wlb,
  albedo_df = albedo_raw,
  constants      = CONSTANTS,
  wlb_end_filter = wlb_end_filter,
  lake_name      = lake_name,
  year_start     = 2024,
  year_end       = 2050,
  flat_offsets        = list(),   # no offsets — baseline scenario
  seasonal_adjustments = list()   # no adjustments — baseline scenario
)

scen_warm <- prepare_model_input(clim_scenario_warm_1,
                                    warming_rate = 0.005,
                                    constants    = CONSTANTS)

results_warm_1 <- run_ice_model(scen_warm, constants = CONSTANTS)

plot_scenario(clim_scenario_warm_1,
              scenario_label = "1% warming scenario 2024–2050",
              smooth = "month")

plot_ice_model(results_scen,
               title = "East Lake Bonney",
               subtitle = "1% Warming | Climatological forcing 2024–2050",
               smooth = "month")

```
